mandatoryAnswer: Qelly is approximately 84-89% complete overall. Prompt 2B remains complete. Prompt 2C implementation is approximately 90-94%, and the existing Supabase Free project is live with 10 RLS-enabled tables and a passing two-user transactional isolation matrix. The all-screens master PDF is complete for the accepted 429-screen corpus. Globally verified public deployment remains 0% because official Cloudflare Pages actions are not authorized in this runtime and GitHub Pages remains environment-blocked. The largest truthful increase is normal Cloudflare OAuth/dashboard authorization, followed by exact-release deployment, Auth email/browser journeys, deployed provider checks, rollback and official LinkedIn publication.
